title: Asahi’s credit in four Aurora repositories
summary: Licence files in four Aurora repositories keep Asahi’s copyright, and the installer keeps Asahi’s commit history.

topics.angle: Where the credit can be seen.
A credit question that can be checked by hand.

claims.text: m1n1, aurora-installer, asahi-audio and avd-fw carry an Asahi copyright line.
GitHub lists marcan with 332 contributions to aurora-installer, second to DjDeveloperr with 589.
This does not test Asahi’s claim about unreleased code.

to_find: The same check on the kernel, u-boot and Mesa forks
Any file whose origin is disputed
would_change: One Aurora file shown to carry Asahi code without its notice.
